prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, industry, timeline, and whether you need local face-to-face work or remote support.

To recommend the best fit for you, tell me:
- What services do you need? (SEO, PPC, social, content, branding, web/app development, PR, email, B2B demand gen, etc.)
- What’s your industry or target market?
- Rough budget (monthly or project)?
- Company size (startup, SMB, enterprise)?
- Timeline and key goals (lead volume, sales, brand awareness, product launch)?
- Do you prefer an agency in Maryland for in-person meetings or is remote okay?

If you want to start researching yourself, good ways to find strong candidates are:
- Review portfolios/case studies and client testimonials
- Look at industry directories (Clutch, UpCity) and local business awards (Baltimore Business Journal)
- Ask for KPIs and reporting examples, team bios, and a trial project or short pilot
- Check references and recent, measurable results (e.g., % increase in organic traffic or lead costs)

If you give me the details above, I’ll shortlist 4–6 Maryland agencies that best match your needs, with pros/cons and suggested next steps. Which services and budget are you working with?
